species.name: Mortal-Kin
species.description: Naturally born peoples — humans, smallfolk, giant-blooded peoples, orcish and goblinoid peoples, and other broadly mortal lineages. They vary dramatically in stature, proportions, endurance, and sensory ability.

adaptations.name: Compact Frame
adaptations.text: You may move through spaces occupied by substantially larger creatures, though you cannot end your movement in an occupied space. You can also pass through narrow openings and comfortably use spaces designed for creatures roughly half your height, provided your equipment fits.

adaptations.name: Hardy
adaptations.text: Ordinary environmental exposure takes three times as long to affect you. The first time each adventure an ordinary environmental hazard would cause you Damage, reduce that Damage to 0. This does not prevent Breach.

adaptations.name: Keen
adaptations.text: Choose two special Senses: low-light vision, keen hearing, or keen scent. Within 2 units, creatures and objects cannot remain Hidden from you when the chosen Sense could reasonably detect them and no sealed barrier blocks it.

adaptations.name: Long-Limbed
adaptations.text: You may reach, retrieve, manipulate, or operate unattended objects up to 1 unit farther away than normal. This does not increase the range of attacks, Reactions, Combat Cards, or other effects targeting creatures.

adaptations.name: Powerful Build
adaptations.text: You count as substantially larger when lifting, carrying, pushing, dragging, or breaking ordinary objects. You may carry one willing or incapacitated character without reducing your Movement, provided their total size and equipment are within what your body could reasonably support.

adaptations.name: Stout
adaptations.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 2 units, to a minimum of 0. Ordinary wind, currents, unstable footing, and similar environmental forces must be severe before they can move or knock you down.

adaptations.name: Sure-Footed
adaptations.text: Ignore the first 2 units of difficult terrain you cross during each turn. You can maintain your footing on ordinary narrow, uneven, or unstable surfaces without special assistance.

adaptations.name: Swift
adaptations.text: Increase your Movement to 12 units.

adaptations.name: Tireless
adaptations.text: Ordinary travel and sustained physical labor take three times as long to cause exhaustion or similar consequences. The first time each adventure fatigue or lack of rest would impose a condition or cause Damage, ignore that consequence.

species.name: Feyborn
species.description: Beings whose bodies and spirits are intertwined with glamour, dreams, emotion, living nature, or shadow. Includes woodland peoples, fair folk, winged sprites, horned revelers, embodied nature spirits, dreamborn beings, and changelings.

nature.name: Between Places
nature.text: You may move through spaces occupied by other creatures, though you cannot end your movement in an occupied space. Choose one Feyborn Adaptation.

adaptations.name: Dreamtouched
adaptations.text: You remain aware of your surroundings while resting. The first time each scene an effect alters your perception, memory, dreams, or emotions, you immediately recognize that an outside influence is affecting you, even if you cannot identify its source or prevent its effects.

adaptations.name: Glamour
adaptations.text: After one minute of concentration, you may assume a different appearance within your general size and body plan. You may alter your apparent lineage, age, coloration, voice, scent, clothing, and similar details. Ordinary observation cannot identify the Glamour as false, though touch, deliberate examination, and supernatural Senses may reveal inconsistencies.

adaptations.name: Glimmerwing
adaptations.text: You possess wings or another supernatural means of controlled descent. While falling, you may glide using your full Movement and may Dash normally. You cannot gain height through this Adaptation or remain airborne without descending.

adaptations.name: Greenstep
adaptations.text: Natural vegetation, undergrowth, mud, roots, and similar natural terrain do not count as difficult terrain for you. You also gain Climb 5 when climbing living plants or natural rock.

adaptations.name: Gloamstep
adaptations.text: Gain low-light vision. The first time each turn you enter dim light, darkness, or substantial shadow, move 1 additional unit without spending Movement.

adaptations.name: Veiled Presence
adaptations.text: You may suppress the visible and sensory signs of your supernatural nature. While suppressed, ordinary magical or spiritual detection recognizes that you are alive but does not automatically identify you as Feyborn. Direct examination or an effect specifically designed to reveal Species may still expose you.

adaptations.name: Wild Escape
adaptations.text: The first time each scene another creature would prevent your movement, restrain you, or reduce your Movement to 0, you may immediately move 1 unit after that effect resolves. This movement cannot pass through a solid barrier.

species.name: Planarborn
species.description: Peoples fundamentally shaped by an elemental, celestial, infernal, astral, or void force. Choose an Origin (Earth, Stone, Metal, Crystal, Flame, Water, Air, Frost, Storm, Celestial, Infernal, Astral, Void, or similar).

nature.name: Planar Attunement
nature.text: Ordinary environmental exposure directly associated with your Origin does not harm you. You immediately recognize significant manifestations of that Origin and can sense a concealed concentration within 2 units, provided it is not contained behind a sealed supernatural barrier. This does not protect you from attacks or other hostile effects. Choose one Planarborn Adaptation.

adaptations.name: Aegis of Origin
adaptations.text: Gain one narrow Resistance associated with your Origin. The Resistance must be approved by the GM and cannot apply to an overly broad category of Damage.

adaptations.name: Dense Form
adaptations.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit. You also count as substantially larger when lifting, carrying, pushing, or resisting ordinary environmental forces.

adaptations.name: Shaper
adaptations.text: Once per turn, you may manipulate a small amount of ordinary material or energy associated with your Origin in an adjacent unoccupied space. You may create or remove 1 unit of difficult terrain, produce a simple shape, or cause a comparable environmental change. You may maintain only one altered space at a time.

adaptations.name: Planar Vessel
adaptations.text: Once per adventure, when you would spend the final point of one of your Resources, retain 1 point instead. The Resource must be chosen when you select this Adaptation and should reflect your Origin.

species.name: Beastfolk
species.description: Sapient peoples whose defining physical qualities are drawn from animals — mammals, birds, reptiles, insects, or combinations. Choose an animal or group that informs appearance and traits.

nature.name: Heightened Instincts
nature.text: Choose a narrow special Sense appropriate to your lineage (low-light vision, keen hearing, keen scent, heat perception, or vibration sense). Within 2 units, creatures and objects cannot remain Hidden from you when that Sense could reasonably detect them and no sealed barrier blocks it. You may also follow fresh trails using that Sense without specialized equipment.

adaptations.name: Burrower
adaptations.text: Gain Burrow 5 through loose soil, sand, snow, or similarly workable material. You cannot burrow through solid stone, worked flooring, or reinforced structures.

adaptations.name: Climber
adaptations.text: Gain Climb 10. When a surface can support you, you may remain secured to it without using your hands.

adaptations.name: Glider
adaptations.text: While falling, you may glide using your full Movement and may Dash normally. You cannot gain height through this Adaptation or remain airborne without descending.

adaptations.name: Natural Armament
adaptations.text: Choose claws, horns, fangs, a tail, mandibles, or another natural weapon. It counts as a basic one-handed weapon, does not count against your Signature Equipment Limit, and cannot be disarmed. You must leave one hand or equivalent limb free while using it.

adaptations.name: Prehensile Limb
adaptations.text: You possess a tail, trunk, secondary arm, or similar limb. It may hold and use one small Off-Hand item with a cost of 1 that is not a weapon or shield. The item still counts against your Signature Equipment Limit, and the limb does not grant additional Actions.

adaptations.name: Quadrupedal Frame
adaptations.text: Increase your Movement to 12 while no more than one of your hands is occupied. You also count as substantially larger when carrying riders, dragging loads, or resisting effects that would knock you down.

adaptations.name: Shell or Hide
adaptations.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit. The first time each adventure an ordinary environmental hazard would cause you Damage, reduce that Damage to 0.

adaptations.name: Swimmer
adaptations.text: Gain Swim 10 and increase the amount of time you can remain underwater to ten times the normal duration. This does not allow you to breathe underwater.

species.name: Dragonkin
species.description: Peoples descended from dragons, created in their image, or shaped by draconic power. Choose a Draconic Lineage: Flame, Frost, Storm, Stone, Venom, Radiance, Shadow, or similar.

nature.name: Draconic Core
nature.text: Ordinary environmental exposure associated with your Draconic Lineage does not harm you. You may project a brief, harmless manifestation of your Lineage up to 1 unit away (ignite or extinguish tinder, chill or warm a small object, scatter loose material, produce light, create a sharp sound, or cause another comparable environmental effect). Sense: Low-Light Vision.

adaptations.name: Burrowing Claws
adaptations.text: Gain Burrow 5 through loose earth, sand, snow, or similarly workable material.

adaptations.name: Draconic Armament
adaptations.text: Choose claws, horns, fangs, or a tail as a natural weapon. It counts as a basic one-handed weapon, does not count against your Signature Equipment Limit, and cannot be disarmed. You must leave one hand or equivalent limb free while using it.

adaptations.name: Hoard Sense
adaptations.text: After handling an object for one minute, you may claim it as part of your hoard. While it remains within the same region, you know its general direction and whether it is moving. You may have only one claimed object at a time. You can also identify an examined object's primary material, general quality, and whether it is an obvious imitation.

adaptations.name: Lineage Scales
adaptations.text: The first time each scene you take Damage from a source directly associated with your Draconic Lineage, reduce that Damage by 1. This protection does not prevent Breach.

adaptations.name: Tail Balance
adaptations.text: Ignore the first unit of difficult terrain you cross each turn and reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit.

adaptations.name: True Breath
adaptations.text: Once per scene, release your Draconic Lineage in a 2-unit cone. You may make the affected spaces difficult terrain, clear ordinary smoke or loose material from them, or create an appropriate visual obstruction until the start of your next turn. This Adaptation does not directly cause Damage.

adaptations.name: Wings
adaptations.text: While falling, you may glide using your full Movement and may Dash normally. You cannot gain height through this Adaptation or remain airborne without descending.

species.name: Tideborn
species.description: Aquatic and amphibious peoples adapted to oceans, rivers, swamps, reefs, flooded caverns, and other submerged environments. May resemble fish, amphibians, marine mammals, cephalopods, crustaceans, or aquatic reptiles.

nature.name: Amphibious Body
nature.text: Gain Swim 10. You can breathe both air and water and function normally while submerged. Ordinary water pressure, currents, and temperature within habitable depths do not impair you.

adaptations.name: Adhesive Limbs
adaptations.text: Gain Climb 10 through suckers, gripping pads, hooked limbs, or a similar adaptation. You may remain secured to a surface without using your hands.

adaptations.name: Bioluminescence
adaptations.text: You may produce or suppress light from your body. By touching a creature or object, you may leave a luminous mark that remains until the end of the scene or until deliberately removed. Ordinary darkness does not conceal a marked target.

adaptations.name: Echolocation
adaptations.text: Within 3 units, visual darkness, smoke, and similar visual concealment do not prevent you from perceiving shapes and movement. Echolocation does not reveal color, writing, or fine visual detail and is blocked by effects that prevent sound.

adaptations.name: Electric Sense
adaptations.text: While submerged, you detect living creatures within 3 units through the electrical activity of their bodies. This reveals their approximate location even through visual concealment, but not their identity or condition.

adaptations.name: Flexible Body
adaptations.text: You can pass through narrow openings that can accommodate your equipment and may move through spaces occupied by other creatures. You cannot end your movement in an occupied space or pass through sealed barriers.

adaptations.name: Ink Cloud
adaptations.text: Once per scene while submerged, create a 1-unit area of opaque ink adjacent to you. Ordinary sight cannot pass through the area. The cloud remains until the start of your next turn or until dispersed by a strong current.

adaptations.name: Jet Propulsion
adaptations.text: Increase your Swim Movement to 12. The first time you Dash while swimming during each turn, move 1 additional unit.

species.name: Verdant
species.description: Living plants, fungal colonies, coral-like organisms, animated wood, or other beings whose bodies grow rather than develop as ordinary flesh.

nature.name: Rooted Life
nature.text: You do not require conventional food; choose an appropriate source of nourishment (sunlight, water, minerals, decay, or organic matter). At the end of your turn, you may become Rooted while in contact with a stable surface. While Rooted, your Movement is 0 and involuntary movement against you is reduced by 2 units. You may cease being Rooted at the start of your turn.

adaptations.name: Barked Form
adaptations.text: While Rooted, increase your Resilience by 1. This bonus ends immediately when you cease being Rooted.

adaptations.name: Blooming
adaptations.text: At the beginning of each adventure, produce one simple organic Temporary Item with Availability 1 (food, medicine ingredients, resin, fiber, dye, light-producing growth, or a similar nonweapon item). It decays or becomes unusable at the end of the adventure.

adaptations.name: Mycelial Sense
adaptations.text: While touching natural soil, connected roots, or fungal growth, you detect the movement and approximate location of creatures touching the same surface within 3 units. Visual concealment does not prevent this detection.

adaptations.name: Photosynthetic Reserve
adaptations.text: Once per adventure, after spending at least ten minutes in contact with your chosen source of nourishment, recover 1 point of one Resource.

adaptations.name: Regrowth
adaptations.text: The first time each adventure a Wound Condition or other effect would disable one of your limbs or Senses, that limb or Sense remains functional until the end of the current scene. Minor lost body parts regrow during recovery.

adaptations.name: Spore Cloud
adaptations.text: Once per scene, create a 1-unit area of spores, pollen, or drifting growth adjacent to you. The area blocks ordinary sight until the start of your next turn.

adaptations.name: Symbiotic Growth
adaptations.text: You possess an additional vine, tendril, branch, or symbiotic organism. It may hold and use one small Off-Hand item with a cost of 1 that is not a weapon or shield. The item still counts against your Signature Equipment Limit, and the growth does not grant additional Actions.

adaptations.name: Vine-Limbed
adaptations.text: Gain Climb 10. You may remain secured to a suitable surface without using your hands.

species.name: Deathless
species.description: Characters who continue to exist after ordinary biological life has ended, or are sustained between life and death. May depend upon necromancy, spiritual force, hunger, memory, shadow, or unfinished purpose.

nature.name: Deathless Nature
nature.text: You do not need to breathe or eat and do not sleep in the ordinary manner. Ordinary biological diseases and poisons do not affect you, though you must still rest and recover normally. When your Critical Wound activates the Death Track, increase its starting value by 1. Sense: Low-Light Vision.

adaptations.name: Borrowed Life
adaptations.text: After one minute of preparation, you may imitate the visible signs of life, including warmth, breathing, coloration, and a heartbeat. Ordinary observation cannot identify you as Deathless, though deliberate medical or supernatural examination may reveal your nature.

adaptations.name: Detached Scout
adaptations.text: You may detach a small sensory part of your body (an eye, hand, tooth, or fragment of bone) and perceive through it while it remains within 5 units. It cannot move on its own, and you lose the corresponding Sense or function from your main body while it is detached.

adaptations.name: Grave Sense
adaptations.text: You detect whether creatures within 3 units are living, dead, Deathless, or artificially animated. Ordinary visual concealment does not block this Sense, though sealed barriers do.

adaptations.name: Shadowed Soul
adaptations.text: The first time each turn you enter dim light or darkness, move 1 additional unit without spending Movement.

adaptations.name: Spectral Flexibility
adaptations.text: You may move through spaces occupied by other creatures and pass through narrow openings that can accommodate your equipment. You cannot end your movement in an occupied space or pass through solid walls and sealed barriers.

adaptations.name: Stitched Form
adaptations.text: You possess an additional arm, skeletal limb, tendril, or other appendage. It may hold and use one small Off-Hand item with a cost of 1 that is not a weapon or shield. The item still counts against your Signature Equipment Limit, and the limb does not grant additional Actions.

adaptations.name: Uncanny Stillness
adaptations.text: You can remain motionless indefinitely and display no involuntary signs of life. While Hidden and motionless, ordinary visual observation does not reveal you unless someone performs a deliberate search.

adaptations.name: Unyielding Remains
adaptations.text: The first time each adventure a Wound Condition would reduce your Movement, disable a limb, or impair one of your Senses, ignore that portion of the condition until the end of the current scene.

species.name: Constructs
species.description: Artificial peoples created through machinery, magic, alchemy, or craftsmanship. Bodies may be metal, stone, wood, ceramic, crystal, synthetic flesh, or other designed materials. The chosen Module may be replaced during significant downtime.

nature.name: Artificial Nature
nature.text: You do not need to breathe or eat and do not sleep in the ordinary manner. Ordinary biological diseases and poisons do not affect you, though you must still rest and recover normally.

adaptations.name: Alternate Chassis
adaptations.text: Gain Climb 10 or Swim 10 through a body specifically designed for that form of Movement.

adaptations.name: Anchor Mode
adaptations.text: At the end of your turn, you may anchor yourself to a stable surface. While anchored, your Movement is 0 and involuntary movement against you is reduced to 0. You may release the anchor at the start of your turn.

adaptations.name: Integrated Tool
adaptations.text: Choose one ordinary Non-Combat toolkit and incorporate it into your body. It does not count against your Signature Equipment Limit, cannot be disarmed, and remains available whenever the relevant parts of your body are functional.

adaptations.name: Internal Compartment
adaptations.text: Choose one small Other Equipment item with a cost of 1 whose Availability does not exceed your Reach. While installed inside your body, it does not count against your Signature Equipment Limit and is not discovered through casual observation. You may replace it during significant downtime.

adaptations.name: Redundant Systems
adaptations.text: The first time each adventure a Wound Condition or other effect would disable one of your limbs, Senses, or Movement modes, that function remains available until the end of the current scene.

adaptations.name: Reinforced Frame
adaptations.text: Reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit. If you have not moved during the current turn, reduce it by 2 units instead.

adaptations.name: Sensor Suite
adaptations.text: Choose two special Senses (low-light vision, keen hearing, heat perception, vibration sense, or another narrow Sense approved by the GM). Within 2 units, creatures and objects cannot remain Hidden from you when one of those Senses could reasonably detect them.

adaptations.name: Utility Limb
adaptations.text: You possess an additional arm, tool mount, cable, or similar mechanism. It may hold and use one small Off-Hand item with a cost of 1 that is not a weapon or shield. The item still counts against your Signature Equipment Limit, and the limb does not grant additional Actions.

heritages.name: Warcamp Raised
heritages.description: Raised among soldiers, camp followers, quartermasters, healers, and families that traveled with an army or lived around a permanent garrison.

legacy.name: Quartermaster's Due
legacy.text: You may select one Main-Hand, Off-Hand, or Armor item whose Availability is no more than 1 higher than your Reach. It still counts against your Signature Equipment Limit. You may replace it at the end of an adventure or during significant downtime.

familiarity.name: Camp Discipline
familiarity.text: You recognize common military ranks, unit markings, signals, supply arrangements, watch rotations, and camp layouts. You can move through an organized military position without disrupting operations and know how to approach the proper person for supplies, information, or an audience. This grants no military rank or authority.

heritages.name: Merchant Family
heritages.description: Raised around shops, caravans, counting houses, warehouses, or family ventures in which every possession had a cost and every relationship had practical value.

legacy.name: Family Ledger
legacy.text: At the beginning of each adventure, gain 1 Temporary Influence, up to your normal maximum. Any Temporary Influence granted by this Legacy that remains at the end of the adventure is lost.

familiarity.name: Commercial Networks
familiarity.text: You recognize guild marks, shipping labels, trade conventions, common commercial deceptions, and signs of shortage or surplus. In a settlement with an established market, you can identify the brokers, wholesalers, guild representatives, and other people through whom serious business is conducted.

heritages.name: Noble Household
heritages.description: Born or raised within a titled family, political dynasty, landed household, or another lineage whose name carries recognized social weight.

legacy.name: Letters of Standing
legacy.text: When dealing with an established institution (merchant guild, government office, temple, academy, military command), treat your Reach as 1 higher and gain 1 Temporary Influence usable only during that scene. The first use each adventure is free; each additional use causes 1 Influence Breach.

familiarity.name: Unspoken Precedence
familiarity.text: You understand formal etiquette, inheritance, favors, veiled insults, and the difference between official title and practical authority. In elite gatherings you can recognize who holds informal influence and when an apparently polite gesture carries political meaning.

heritages.name: Artisan Household
heritages.description: Grew up in a smithy, workshop, mill, studio, construction yard, or another household centered on skilled production.

legacy.name: Inherited Tools
legacy.text: Choose one ordinary toolkit during character creation. It does not count against your Signature Equipment Limit. You may replace it at the end of any adventure or during significant downtime.

familiarity.name: Workshop Rhythm
familiarity.text: You recognize common materials, construction methods, maker's marks, rushed workmanship, and obvious substitutions. You understand workshop hierarchy and can approach laborers, apprentices, and craftspeople without behaving like an intrusive outsider.

heritages.name: Academy Raised
heritages.description: Raised among tutors, books, archives, laboratories, or institutions devoted to formal study and the preservation of knowledge.

legacy.name: Formal Education
legacy.text: Gain 1 additional Non-Combat Skill Point during character creation. This point cannot raise a Skill above the normal starting limit.

familiarity.name: Institutional Literacy
familiarity.text: You understand academic organization, citation, archival procedure, and the politics of formal scholarship. You can recognize obvious censorship, deliberate omissions, and records written to satisfy institutional expectations. You know how to identify the proper archive, specialist, or department when seeking information.

heritages.name: Temple Raised
heritages.description: Raised within a temple, monastery, shrine, religious family, or institution whose doctrine and observances shaped daily life.

legacy.name: Sacred Trust
legacy.text: The first time each adventure you would take Influence Damage, you may reduce that damage to 0. This protection does not prevent Influence Breach.

familiarity.name: Sacred Practice
familiarity.text: You recognize common symbols, rituals, offices, doctrinal divisions, and forms of address used by established religious institutions. You can identify when a public observance differs from accepted practice, though you do not automatically know the reason.

heritages.name: Underworld Raised
heritages.description: Grew up among crowded streets, informal shelters, smugglers, thieves, fences, and people who survived outside official systems.

legacy.name: Fence's Cache
legacy.text: At the end of each adventure, you may preserve one Temporary Item instead of discarding it (your Cached Item). When you have access to a black market or fence, you may exchange it for another Temporary Item of equal or lower Availability (cannot exceed your Reach).

familiarity.name: Quiet Rules
familiarity.text: You recognize territorial signs, protection arrangements, false storefronts, informal shelters, hidden markets, secondary routes, and the people who actually control illicit trade. You know how to find a discreet intermediary, safe meeting place, or overlooked refuge without presenting yourself as an obvious victim or agent of authority.

heritages.name: Caravan Family
heritages.description: Raised among traders, performers, pilgrims, nomads, couriers, or traveling families for whom roads and temporary camps were home.

legacy.name: Lessons of the Road
legacy.text: At the beginning of each adventure, choose one Non-Combat Skill you do not possess. Treat that Skill as Rank 1 until the end of the adventure.

familiarity.name: Road Lore
familiarity.text: You recognize traveler marks, route warnings, regional accents, common road hazards, and signs that a path is less safe than it appears. In an unfamiliar settlement, you can quickly locate places where outsiders arrange passage, seek work, exchange news, and trade informal favors.

heritages.name: Frontier Household
heritages.description: Grew up in an isolated settlement, border territory, remote colony, or community that could not depend upon immediate aid from outside.

legacy.name: Prepared Cache
legacy.text: You may reveal that you previously packed, purchased, or concealed one ordinary non-combat item appropriate to the current environment (Availability ≤ Reach; not a weapon, armor, Focus, relic, or combat consumable). It becomes Temporary Equipment. First use each adventure is free; each additional use causes 1 Influence Breach.

familiarity.name: Borderland Vigilance
familiarity.text: You recognize how isolated communities organize alarms, food stores, shelters, escape routes, and defensive positions. You can identify practical vulnerabilities and signs that a community expects attack, shortage, or abandonment.

distinctions.name: Athlete
distinctions.description: Combatants who have pushed their physical capabilities through discipline, experience, or relentless conditioning — brawlers, duelists, soldiers, martial artists, bodyguards.
distinctions.benefit: Gain one additional Prowess Expertise and two additional Prowess Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Prowess to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Prowess Expertise and four additional Prowess Action Cards.

origin.name: Peak Performance
origin.text: Increase your Resilience by 1. During your first turn, Movement that brings you closer to an enemy costs half as much Movement.

distinctions.name: Marksman
distinctions.description: Combatants who project force accurately across the battlefield — archers, snipers, gunslingers, siege specialists, and anyone who relies on distance, precision, and careful target selection.
distinctions.benefit: Gain one additional Ballistics Expertise and two additional Ballistics Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Ballistics to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Ballistics Expertise and four additional Ballistics Action Cards.

origin.name: Split Focus
origin.text: You may maintain two Locks at once. If you would establish a Lock on a third creature, choose which existing Lock ends.

distinctions.name: Gifted
distinctions.description: Characters whose capabilities are part of what they are rather than something learned. They unleash these qualities through powerful transformations, quickly shifting form to fill whatever role is needed.
distinctions.benefit: Gain access to the Gestalt Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Gestalt, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Gestalt Expertise and two additional Gestalt Action Cards.

origin.name: Efficient Transformation
origin.text: Reduce the Stamina cost of transformation upkeep by 1, to a minimum of 1.

distinctions.name: Strategist
distinctions.description: Problem-solvers, infiltrators, engineers, field medics, tacticians, and manipulators who win by understanding what is likely to happen before it occurs.
distinctions.benefit: Gain one additional Cunning Expertise and two additional Cunning Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Cunning to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Cunning Expertise and four additional Cunning Action Cards.

origin.name: Branching Plans
origin.text: You may establish a second Contingency each round. You may still trigger only one Contingency per round.

distinctions.name: Psyker
distinctions.description: Characters whose minds operate beyond ordinary limits. Abilities may manifest as telekinetic force, mental influence, expanded perception, projected thought, or other expressions of focused consciousness.
distinctions.benefit: Gain access to the Psionics Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Psionics, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Psionics Expertise and two additional Psionics Action Cards.

origin.name: Sacrificial Power
origin.text: You may spend Temporary Wounds as though they were dice when using Psionics Actions or Reactions.

distinctions.name: Arcanist
distinctions.description: Characters who approach supernatural power as a system that can be studied, constructed, and refined. Their actions create magical components that interact with later actions, building increasingly complex effects.
distinctions.benefit: Gain access to the Magecraft Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Magecraft, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Magecraft Expertise and two additional Magecraft Action Cards.

origin.name: Elemental Versatility
origin.text: The first time you use an Action Card of a given element during an encounter, gain one additional Surge for that action.

distinctions.name: Orator
distinctions.description: Battlefield commanders, officers, champions, performers, and leaders whose presence changes how others fight. They issue orders, provoke enemies, raise standards, and lead through personal action.
distinctions.benefit: Gain one additional Leadership Expertise and two additional Leadership Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Leadership to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Leadership Expertise and four additional Leadership Action Cards.

origin.name: Commanding Authority
origin.text: Whenever you would store Authority, you may choose up to two results rolled for that Leadership action and store both. When you spend that Authority, choose which stored result is used, then discard both.

distinctions.name: Invoker
distinctions.description: Characters who prepare supernatural effects that bind power into creatures, objects, locations, and declared conditions — layering Wards, Hexes, Rites, and other effects across the battlefield.
distinctions.benefit: Gain access to the Ritualism Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Ritualism, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Ritualism Expertise and two additional Ritualism Action Cards.

origin.name: Final Echo
origin.text: You may maintain one additional Rite. Once per round, when you remove one of your Rites to establish another, you may resolve the removed Rite's Echo once before removing it. Ignore its Trigger and choose any valid target or area.

distinctions.name: Summoner
distinctions.description: Conduits who forge bonds with entities, forces, or powers beyond the material world. They channel bonds into healing and support, then allow a summoned entity to fully manifest.
distinctions.benefit: Gain access to the Calling Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Calling, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Calling Expertise and two additional Calling Action Cards.

origin.name: Greater Manifestation
origin.text: Full Manifestations cost one fewer die than normal, to a minimum cost of 2 dice.

distinctions.name: Dilettante
distinctions.description: Characters defined by breadth and versatility rather than a single overwhelming specialty. They keep several strong options ready and adapt to what the situation requires. Unlocks no restricted skill. May only be selected at character creation.
distinctions.benefit: Whenever you gain a pip in a Combat Skill, also gain one Action Card of that Rank or lower for that Combat Skill.

origin.name: Broad Reserves
origin.text: Increase your maximum Stamina, Focus, and Mana by 5 each.
